card.name: First letter of GAZYVA and split words
card.fires_on: The first letter G of the brand name GAZYVA (obinutuzumab) after words like 'of' or 'including'. It also fires on the first piece of other split words, such as 'rep' in repaid or republished and 'P' in Père or Prenzlauer.
